stories.title: Fast alle Opfer waren mit dem Täter verwandt: Neun Tote nach Schüssen in Pennsylvania

en.title: Nearly all victims were related to the shooter: Nine dead after shooting in Pennsylvania
en.summary: A man carried out a mass shooting of family members in a small U.S. town. The victims included children and a heavily pregnant woman.

stories.title: Mit der Mekka-Allianz ordnet sich der Nahe Osten militärisch gerade völlig neu

en.title: With the Mecca Alliance, the Middle East is undergoing complete military realignment
en.summary: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey formed an alliance in response to insufficient U.S. protection and as a counter to the Israel-United Arab Emirates partnership.

stories.title: Von der Schweiz schwärmen und dafür bezahlt werden: Nina Chuba übernimmt das Privileg von Roger Federer

en.title: Praising Switzerland and getting paid for it: Nina Chuba takes over the privilege of Roger Federer
en.summary: German artist Nina Chuba has been hired to promote Swiss autumn holidays for a fee, following in the footsteps of retired ambassador Roger Federer who now resides in Rapperswil-Jona.

stories.title: Machtkampf von Mourinho und Mbappé – Showdown in der Innerschweiz

en.title: Power struggle between Mourinho and Mbappé – showdown in central Switzerland
en.summary: Real Madrid's coach prohibits his stars from riding bicycles. Kylian Mbappé finds this restriction amusing.

stories.title: Der Zollstreit zwischen Kanada und den USA entzweit auch zwei Grenzgemeinden. Auf der einen Seite wird gepoltert, auf der anderen geschwiegen

en.title: Tariff dispute between Canada and the USA divides two border communities
en.summary: Two neighboring towns separated by the St. Clair River, one in Canada and one in the USA, face growing tension as Canadian residents reduce cross-border visits following Trump's tariff threats and annexation statements, while American neighbors remain quiet about the situation.

stories.title: «House of Magdeburg»: Nach der Wahl eines AfD-Politikers zum Landtagspräsidenten liegen die Nerven blank

en.title: "House of Magdeburg": After election of an AfD politician as Landtag president, tensions run high
en.summary: An AfD politician was elected Landtag president in Saxony-Anhalt with votes that apparently no one claims to have cast, raising questions about which party is responsible and accelerating the fragmentation of Germany's political center.

stories.title: Mit Präsident Flávio Bolsonaro droht dem Amazonasgebiet in Brasilien neue Gefahr

en.title: With President Flávio Bolsonaro, the Amazon region in Brazil faces new danger
en.summary: Brazil's president plans to follow his father's policies by opening the rainforest to mining and agriculture, capitalizing on global demand for raw materials.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - «Die Schweiz macht sich zur Komplizin von China» – der Präsident der tibetischen Exilregierung warnt davor, wirtschaftliche Interessen über die Menschenrechte zu stellen

en.title: INTERVIEW - "Switzerland makes itself complicit in China" – President of Tibetan exile administration warns against prioritizing economic interests over human rights
en.summary: The Swiss government plans to sign a new free trade agreement with China, while the political leader of Tibetan exiles visits Switzerland to criticize Beijing's treatment of minorities.

stories.title: Schweizer Online-Giganten bezweifeln, dass sich die KI-Agenten fürs Shopping durchsetzen werden

en.title: Swiss online giants doubt that AI shopping agents will catch on
en.summary: Galaxus and Brack are preparing for digital shopping assistants, but they question whether such AI agents will achieve widespread adoption in Switzerland.

stories.title: Von wegen Exodus: Die Banken hassen Zürich, aber investieren trotzdem massiv

en.title: No exodus: Banks dislike Zurich but invest heavily there nonetheless
en.summary: Vontobel and Cembra are investing hundreds of millions in Zurich despite concerns about business conditions, contradicting predictions of a banking exodus from the city.

stories.title: Wie die Emirate aus einer Expat-Oase zum Kriegstreiber wurden

en.title: How the Emirates transformed from an expat haven to a conflict instigator
en.summary: The United Arab Emirates' reputation as a luxury destination has deteriorated, particularly since the Iran conflict, while the nation simultaneously involves itself in African civil wars and uses investments to influence governments.

stories.title: Der Literaturnobelpreis an Anne Carson setzt ein Zeichen für die Lyrik

en.title: Literature Nobel Prize to Anne Carson sends a signal for poetry
en.summary: Canadian poet Anne Carson received the Nobel Prize in Literature, a selection that surprised even her German publisher despite her previous consideration as a potential laureate.

en.summary: Large tech companies are earning hundreds of billions but creating few new jobs, widening the gap between capital and labor, though the situation differs in Switzerland.

stories.title: Soll ich sagen, wenn es mir schlechtgeht? Über Offenheit im Büro

en.title: Should I say when I'm not doing well? On openness in the office
en.summary: The workplace requires boundaries around personal life, but completely hiding one's true condition may harm both oneself and workplace relationships, according to workplace commentary.
